variant.name: default
variant.description: The design as committed, with no defines or parameters.

labels.rtl: RTL: clock cycles counted at real clock edges of the Verilated vcpu8_top, from reset release to the stop.
labels.instructionalModel: Instructional model: the emulator’s teaching estimate (@vcpu/cpu-core estimatedCycles, the ISA timing model). It is not a circuit and was not measured.
labels.estimatedTime: Estimated time: RTL cycles / nextpnr Fmax for the named device and timing model, at the place-and-route seed in the synthesis summary. A static timing estimate, not a measurement on hardware.

config.stepLimit: each program’s .expect.json maxInstructions, for both CPUs
config.correctnessGate: Each program runs on @vcpu/cpu-core (live) and on the RTL runner; every trace step and the full end state (registers, flags, PC, SP, SD, status, fault, all 256 memory bytes) must match, and the program must halt. A program that fails gets no numbers.
